title: Comprehensive Laboratory Animal Monitoring System (CLAMS)
author: Peter Takeuchi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yggfttw

steps.title: Pre-Study Acclimation
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals in MBP Vivarium Room 115 for one week prior to the study.

substeps.instruction: Place animals in single housing (duplex cages with clear divider) after transfer.
Introduce sifted powdered version of normal rodent chow via specialized plastic feeders in home cages, in addition to pelleted chow, 2 days before transferring to CLAMS acclimation cages.
Provide de-ionized water with mineral content of approximately 400 PPM (add 6-7 mineral drops to 1L de-ionized water and verify 400-425 PPM via conductivity meter).
Grossly observe and document powdered food and water intake on the Weight/Food/Water Intake Log sheet.

steps.title: CLAMS Room Acclimation
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals in CLAMS acclimation cages for 24 hours in the CLAMS room, maintaining a room temperature of 24°C and a 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights off 18:00, on 06:00; 100-200 lux inside cages).

substeps.instruction: Fill feeders to capacity with powdered feed before 12:00; match food guard size to animal size to prevent foraging.
Weigh mice and record weights on the Weight/Food/Water intake log sheet.
Fill Lixit bottles with de-ionized water (mineral content 400-425 PPM) and place in cage slots.
Supply power to fans for air circulation.
Tighten lids and attach cage cards via the front hinge.
Record the time animals were placed in cages in the Animal and System Monitoring Log sheet.
Post a 'Testing in Progress' sign on the room door and fill out the Animal Monitoring Log Sheet daily.
After 24 hours, weigh animals and document food/water intake on the Weight/Food/Water Intake Log sheet.

Evaluate weight loss: if an animal loses 10-15% of original body weight, inspect for hardware issues; if cause is undetermined, assess feasibility of CLAMS placement on a case-by-case basis or return to home cage.

steps.title: CLAMS Incubator Setup
steps.instruction: Initiate incubator acclimation in the AM (before 12:00).

substeps.instruction: Perform computer set-up and check hardware (Drierite, soda lime, ammonia filter).
Prepare 2 L of de-ionized water; add mineral drops (6-7 drops/L) to achieve 400-425 PPM.
Fill two 1 Liter bottles with the prepared water and record mineral content on the Animal and System Monitoring Log sheet.
Fill water lines using the 'pump status' option in Oxymax software.
Calibrate gases using 20% CO2, Nitrogen balance.
Place mesh food holders with food on balances in the CLAMS apparatus.
Turn on and tare the balances to 0 grams.

steps.title: Incubator Acclimation and Testing
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals in the incubator for 24 hours, followed by 48 hours (or longer) of testing.

substeps.instruction: Weigh animals and note on data sheet.
Place the acclimation cages containing each animal into the incubator and secure the lids.
Set incubator temperature to 22°C and lights (on 06:00, off 18:00; 100-200 lux). Leave door panels off to allow monitoring without opening glass doors.
Start the experiment in Oxymax (Experiment → Run) and begin recording.
Check RER measurements hourly (RER < 0.7 or > 1.3 may indicate cage lid or gas line leakage).
Monitor mice via CLAX program every two hours (08:00-17:00 Mon-Fri) and remotely (21:00-22:00).
Visually check animals before 10:00 and 16:00, documenting food/water intake, activity, RER, and environmental conditions in the Animal and System Remote Monitoring Log sheet.

steps.title: Study Termination and Cleanup
steps.instruction: End the study and perform post-experimental processing.

substeps.instruction: Stop the experiment in Oxymax (Experiment → Stop).
Weigh animals and return them to their home cages.
Determine body composition via DEXA immediately following CLAMS analysis.
Wash and disinfect CLAMS cages; flush water lines with 10% bleach and rinse with deionized water.

Record parameters: Activity (x and z), Food intake (amount, time, accumulated), Water intake (amount, time, accumulated), Sleep (duration/time via Oxymax default parameters), Energy expenditure/heat production, and RER.
Generate individual .csv files from the .CDTA file using Oxymax software.
Combine .csv files into a data folder with the CLAMS data analysis template and run the custom MS Excel-based (Visual Basic) macro to calculate and collate data.

steps.title: Data Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform QC checks on the collected data and system calibration.

substeps.instruction: Verify RER is between 0.7-1.3.
Confirm Drink Accumulated (Drink Acc. 1) is followed by a plateau.
Ensure Feed Accumulated (Feed Acc. 1) contains no 'underload,' 'overload,' or 'No response' messages.
Verify gas calibration according to manufacturer's manual.

Validate/calibrate gas sensors and flow meters using 20% CO2/Nitrogen balance via OxyVal before each run; perform full validation annually or if values are out of range and record in the Laboratory journal.
